messages:
jin: heads-up — saw a customer hit quota while streaming. They got charged for partial tokens after a reconnect. anyone seen this?

lara: saw similar, we treat SSE chunks as final when connection closed, but reconnects sometimes cause double-counting :grimacing:

mike: is the billing based on finalized token counts or on emitted chunks? I thought we only bill after model finishes or chunk is confirmed

jin: our current code increments the per-key token counter on emit_token(), so if client reconnects and server replays prefix, tokens can be counted twice

sam: that matches. handling reconnects is messy — we need idempotency/sessions. propose we use a per-stream session_id and dedupe tokens by (session_id, seq)

alex: +1. but for aborted streams (client disconnected) we might not receive final seq. How do we reconcile for burst quotas?

lara: idea: charge for tokens only when 'commit' event seen or after idle timeout. For streaming, emit tokens but mark them provisional, move to committed on stream_end. Provisional tokens don't count towards hard quota but affect burst

mike: hmm provisional sounds ok but customers expect immediate enforcement for burst. Maybe provisional reduce available burst capacity but not billed until commit

jin: sketch of leaky-bucket + provisional accounting:
```
on_emit(token_count): provisional[user] += token_count; available_burst[user] -= token_count
on_commit(): billed[user] += provisional[user]; provisional[user]=0
on_timeout(): rollback provisional to available_burst
```

sam: edge: if server replays tokens for reconnect, clients will see duplicates. dedupe on session+seq still needed

ratebot: alert: quota-anomaly detected for org:redwood-corp — spike on streaming reconnects at 2024-06-09T12:34:00Z

alex: ops question: do we show provisional tokens in the console? product wants transparency

lara: yes — add 'inflight_tokens' column to per-org dashboard and expose in token-level billing debug

jin: ok I'll open an RFC and a spike branch. plan: implement session_id + provisional accounting + console flag. tagging @eng-platform @eng-sre for rollout/monitoring

mike: :thumbsup: keep it small. maybe start with internal-only feature flag for 2 weeks

jin: thanks — filing RFC now: TICKET-3187
